posts.title: Why Did My Keyboard Freeze?
posts.description: I found the fastest motherboard and CPU that can (in theory!) still play MS-DOS games on an old-school, Sound Blaster compatible card. But on my first attempt, the keyboard froze solid. What gives?

posts.title: Finding the Fastest Possible DOS PC
posts.description: I want to play DOS games on the fastest PC possible, with sound from a real late-90s PCI sound card. But somewhere along the way, PCs stopped being able to talk to these cards. So how fast can a DOS PC with a real sound card actually go?

posts.title: Why Don't PCI Sound Cards Work on a Modern PC?
posts.description: I have a mission: play original DOS games at super high resolutions and frame rates. Graphics turned out to be easy. But sound is the real challenge. Here’s why a late-90s PCI sound card won’t just work in a modern PC.
